newsitem.title: USA: Calvert fund firm names Krumsiek as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Calvert fund firm names Krumsiek as CEO.

text.p: Calvert Group, known for its "socially responsible" mutual funds, said it named Barbara Krumsiek as president and chief executive officer.
Krumsiek replaced Clifton Sorrell, who resigned to pursue other business opportunities.
Krumsiek was a senior vice president at Alliance Capital Management LP and a managing director for its mutual fund unit.
Calvert, a unit of Washington-based Acacia Group, manages more than $5.1 billion in assets in about 30 mutual funds, including about 15 socially responsible funds, and money market portfolios.
Its "socially responsible" funds include Calvert Social Investment Fund, and World Value International Equities Fund.
